correctness.rationale: Write \(W_b\) as \(n\) minus the sum of clean-window indicators. Each clean-window mean is \(r^b\). For offset \(d\), the joint clean event requires exactly \(u_d\) distinct coordinates to avoid substitution, hence probability \(r^{u_d}\); summing all cyclic covariances gives the exact variance. The overlap count includes both possible cyclic intersections and also covers \(b=n\). Rational-arithmetic exhaustive checks reconstruct \(W_b\) directly for all \(n\le9\) and several probabilities, and a larger symbolic grid checks the simplified \(n\ge2b\) form.

value.rationale: The number of corrupted \(b\)-symbol reads is the direct random distortion seen by the \(b\)-symbol channel under the standard independent-substitution model. Its exact mean and variance quantify the amplification and dependence created by overlapping reads, and the \(n\ge2b\) formula gives the exact \(\sqrt n\) fluctuation scale for every fixed \(b\) and \(p\). This is an all-parameter channel statistic, not an arbitrary finite slice or a recomputation of a known code table.
